reviewed_findings.claim: pref_rtos_get_fd opens /dev/mem and requests mapping base0x85400000 length0x80000 through local mmap helper; returned value is cached mapped address.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Only userland request traced; physical ownership, runtime permissions and synchronization unverified.
unresolved_questions: Which component initializes and owns the region?
How are cross-core visibility and lifetime synchronized?

reviewed_findings.claim: Next_Shot_Ready named getter reads one byte at mapped offset0x1c4d and normalizes nonzero to true.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Consumer read only; symbol name does not establish capture or file completion.
unresolved_questions: What state transitions and file/SD ordering does it represent?

reviewed_findings.claim: Lens_Info named getter reads4 bytes at mapped offset0xd28, compares0x330033/0x11223344, logs and returns word.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: No lens-model, command encoding or producer identification.
unresolved_questions: Where are actual lens commands dispatched?

reviewed_findings.claim: Send checks availability and requested length using signed CMP/BGE and CMP/BLT; length>=396 rejected only within nonnegative signed32 domain, then tail-calls ipcc_write_pkt.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Bit31-set lengths compare negative and are not excluded by the stated size test; caller length domain and effective unsigned bound unverified.
unresolved_questions: Do all callers constrain length to nonnegative signed range?

reviewed_findings.claim: read/write packet wrappers issue ioctl0xc0107406/0xc0107407 with16-byte record and return record+8 rather than ioctl r0.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Driver contract unreviewed; output word not initialized in inspected wrappers; no correctness/security claim.
unresolved_questions: How does driver fill record+8 on success/error?
How are partial packet and ioctl failures represented?

reviewed_findings.claim: When supplied identifier!=0x10 and global byte==0, sender calls CFrameQueue::Push then returns-1; alternate branch sends within critical section.
reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Queue insertion result, global lifecycle, identifier semantics and eventual delivery unresolved.
unresolved_questions: Does queued frame reach receiver, and how is completion reported?

reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Queue consumer, supplied string domain and runtime submission result unverified; no exploit or wire-protocol claim.

reviewed_findings.method: Ghidra selected decompilation/instructions; independent pyelftools and Capstone original ARM/Thumb disassembly with ELF relocation/PLT check.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Full ABI and caller context unverified; successful queue submission does not prove processing.
